summary: A Google DeepMind employee announced that users can now toggle visible watermarks on or off for images, videos, and songs generated in Gemini and Flow, with Search support coming soon.

practices.reason: A toggle for visible watermarks changes a UI/API option for teams building on these generative products but is a minor interface change.
practices.quote: You can now toggle visible watermarks on or off in Gemini and Flow, with Search coming next.
